new_processes.name: Staff requisition and analyst recruiting
new_processes.definition: Submitting staff requisition forms and arranging with HR to recruit and interview candidates for open positions.

new_processes.name: Basis position roll-off
new_processes.definition: Making sure traders' basis positions are rolled off the benchmark when due, and following up when they are missed.

new_processes.name: Deal assignment risk summary
new_processes.definition: Preparing summaries, deal runs and P&L sheets showing the risk position of deals being assigned or unwound.

new_processes.name: Intercompany contract inventory
new_processes.definition: Compiling the list of active intercompany contracts in the contract system and marking which are still needed.
